title: Alan Walker & Isabella & Kate O'Ryan - Broken Strings

lines.l: Oh, won't you talk to me
If you want more from me
When you take what you mean

If I could take back all the words
The color you're so deep would it hurt?

I'm hoping the sun's gonna shine tomorrow
Oh, won't you talk to me
If you want more from me
When you take what you mean
Feels like the positive in my heart
